$comment: Intent vocabulary for semantic component search. Keyed by component id; generate-catalog-vectors.mjs refuses to build if a key names a component the catalog does not ship, so this file cannot drift the way a hand-written skill can. Phrases describe what a person is trying to DO when this component is the answer - they are embedded alongside the catalog description, which is written from the implementer's side and often never says the words users search with (cre8-hero's whole description is 'Hero component.'). Keep phrases lowercase, comma-free, purpose-shaped.
